summary: Winch launches no longer stall the wing; cockpit view with instruments.
changes: Fixed: gliders stalled near the top of a winch launch even before full rotation. The winch driver now holds launch speed (1.6 x stall speed, ~105 km/h for a K-21) and eases the power as the cable steepens; a stall on the cable releases it.
A LOW SPEED - LOWER THE NOSE warning on the winch.

Cockpit view from the pilot's seat (fuselage hidden, wings visible) with an instrument panel: airspeed, artificial horizon, altimeter, variometer (with 20 s average), compass, slip ball and g; a yaw string for gliders.
Glider coaching: launch, winch technique, soaring, circuit and landing (instead of powered-aircraft steps).
problems: Holding a fixed 45 degree attitude all the way to the top of a winch launch still bleeds speed (as in real life): lower the nose as the cable steepens.
K-21 preset glides 32:1 (real 34:1).
The San Francisco Bay 40 km standard map package is still missing.

summary: Update banner, version history, undo / redo, faster builds.
changes: The app checks for updates at every start (and every 4 hours) and shows a banner with the new version's summary and known problems.
What's new is shown once after updating; Help → Version history lists every version with its known problems (also VERSIONS.md).
Design studio: undo / redo (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y), a whole drag is one step.
File → Open recent; View → Quick screenshot (Ctrl+Shift+P) of the whole window to Pictures.
Faster GitHub builds: cached wheels and PyInstaller binaries, release published from the assemble job, superseded runs cancelled.
problems: Gliders could stall near the top of a winch launch even before full rotation (the winch pulled harder as the cable steepened). Fixed in 0.12.1.
Carried over from 0.11.1: winch launch speed can peak at 135-145 km/h; K-21 preset glides 32:1 (real 34:1).
The San Francisco Bay 40 km standard map package is still missing.

summary: Glider fixes and a K-21 preset.
changes: Glider tails no longer break at the start of a winch launch or aerotow (proper never-exceed speed).
Glider wheels: main + tail wheel (K-21: nose + main + tail); wing-tip skids; a wing runner at launch.
K-21 two-seat trainer preset.
Winch launches: speed-controlled winch, automatic back-release at the top, weak link.
problems: Winch launch speed can peak at 135-145 km/h, faster than a typical launch (still below the K-21's 150 km/h placard).
K-21 preset: 32:1 best glide and 0.74 m/s minimum sink (real ASK 21: 34:1 and 0.65 m/s).
Released after targeted test runs (gliders, core, studio) rather than the full suite.

changes: Gliders: sailplane sizing, laminar glide polar, winch / aerotow launches, thermals, variometer, airbrakes.
Design studio: engines forward / aft, fine wing height, outer engine pair spacing.
Autosave every two minutes with recovery after an unexpected exit.
F1 in the simulator lists every control.
Installers show their version and are published with each release.
problems: Glider tail broke at the start of every winch launch or aerotow (dive speed derived from the best-glide speed). Fixed in 0.11.1.
Gliders used airliner (tricycle) landing gear and could be placed upside down on the runway. Fixed in 0.11.1.
Winch launches over-sped the glider and the hook never back-released. Fixed in 0.11.1.
The San Francisco Bay 40 km standard map package failed to build.

summary: Choose where to fly; stalls, spins and break-ups.
changes: Flying areas: Lasham, Innsbruck, San Francisco Bay, Queenstown; 40 or 80 km; standard or high detail (downloaded on first use).
Runways are never buried by terrain.
Realistic stalls, spins and T-tail deep stall.
Crashes break the aircraft apart; debriefs explain what happened and how to fix it.
Wind tunnel: strip-by-strip stall, profile drag, lift curve.
Livery, cabin windows, cockpit glazing / canopy, engine intakes.
Maximum positive and negative g for the whole aircraft.
problems: The one-line installer address could be served stale by web caches (old scripts kept running).
The San Francisco Bay 40 km standard map package failed to build.

changes: End the process immediately once everything is saved (no native teardown crash on Windows).
problems: Never published: the release step hit a GitHub network timeout. Its fixes shipped in 0.10.0.
First attempt crashed inside the exit call itself (untyped 64-bit handle).

changes: Real terrain, satellite imagery and runways around Lasham.
Installer: this computer / a drive / a folder; ready-to-run app or from source (with its own Python).
Source copies can update themselves.
problems: Windows installer failed on Windows PowerShell 5.1 (blank release) and on drive roots like D:\ ("not of a legal form"). Fixed in 0.9.5 / 0.10.0.
Windows could crash on exit (access violation after everything was saved). Fixed in 0.10.0.
The macOS installer stopped with "AUTH[@]: unbound variable" (macOS's bash 3.2). Fixed on the main branch the same day.

summary: One-command install, small screens, full screen.
changes: One-line installers for Windows, macOS and Linux.
Window fits small laptop screens; every side panel scrolls.
Collapsible side panels and full screen (F11).
problems: macOS installer failed without a GitHub token (bash 3.2 empty array). Fixed after 0.9.4.
"STALL" warning while parked and a huge endurance figure at idle (fixed in this release).

summary: First published release with the self-updater.
changes: Self-updater, game controllers, backwards-compatible files, OpenGL check, two-panel window.
problems: The update button was disabled for copies run from a source zip (fixed in 0.9.4).
Builds only passed the Windows self-test with Mesa software OpenGL on GitHub's GPU-less machines.

changes: Controller and updater work in progress.
problems: The tag was built with a broken workflow, so no release was published.

summary: Only distributed as a source zip.
changes: Design studio, wind tunnel, flight simulator with autopilot and four airports, stunt planes.
problems: No packaged release (workflow broken); the source copy couldn't use the update button.
